message.content: {"count":3,"rationale":"Block jumpHost:lateralMovement, backupHost:lateralMovement, and printServer:lateralMovement. This disables dbReplica and mailArchive, as well as localAdmin and secretsManager, thereby disabling shareMount and codeRepo. All four parents of the target are unreachable. At least three blocks are necessary because three successful attack derivations have disjoint blockable steps: {kerberoast, jumpHost, mailArchive}, {tokenCache, backupHost, shareMount}, and {sshKey, ciRunner, dbLogin, printServer, dbReplica}. Each derivation is supported directly by entry footholds and must have at least one of its steps blocked."}
